title: Search your documents from another PC
description: NEEDS-OWNER: this cannot be recorded in the single-machine sandbox — it needs the separate ScanFinder Search Client app running on a SECOND PC, connected over your network to the main computer. This file is a narration/caption SKELETON only: every step is a still-frame slide (no live automation, no verified selectors). Record it manually on a second machine, then re-time the steps to the real screens. Flow and narration are based on client/ and docs/detached-client.md (connect by address + port ~8765, verify the certificate once, sign in, then search exactly like the built-in Search).

steps.narration: Scan Finder can also run as a small search client on other PCs on your network, so anyone can find and open filed documents without sitting at the main computer.
steps.caption: Search from another PC

steps.narration: On the second PC you open the client and point it at the main computer — its address and port, usually eight-seven-six-five.
steps.caption: Connect to the main computer

steps.narration: The first time, it checks the main computer's security certificate, so the connection is private and trusted from then on.
steps.caption: Verify the certificate once

steps.narration: You sign in with your own account, and the client only shows what your role is allowed to see.
steps.caption: Sign in with your account

steps.narration: After that it works exactly like the Search you've already seen: type a word, open the page, zoom and read.
steps.caption: Search, open and read — just like at the desk

steps.narration: This one needs a second machine and your network to show properly, so it's recorded on real hardware rather than in the practice sandbox.
steps.caption: Recorded on real hardware
